name: OECD Data API
tagline: Free SDMX REST access to OECD country statistics and economic indicators
description: The OECD Data API exposes OECD statistical datasets through the SDMX REST standard, covering economic, social, environmental, and development indicators for member and partner countries. Developers query data flows, structures, and observations without an API key. Responses are typically SDMX-JSON or other SDMX formats suitable for research, dashboards, and cross-country comparisons.

auth.details: No API key or registration required for the public SDMX REST endpoints.

pricing.free_tier_limits: Free public access; no published request quotas on the free tier

use_cases: fetch OECD GDP or national accounts series for a country
list available OECD dataflows and data structures via SDMX
compare economic or social indicators across member countries
pull time-series observations for dashboards or research notebooks
download structural metadata (codelists, concepts) for an OECD dataset
